subject: Request: Whitepine enterprise bundle — exec approval for premium support + custom SOW
messages:
From: Ana Ruiz <ana@whitepinehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@whitepinehealth.com>
Date: 2027-03-29T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing & scope for enterprise bundle (premium support + onboarding + S3 connector)

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Whitepine is ready to move forward contingent on a few items we need to lock down for procurement and security:

- 24/7 premium support (phone + Slack) with a named escalation engineer (we prefer a single point of contact during onboarding).
- Dedicated onboarding engineer for up to 8 weeks to deliver integration and runbooks.
- Custom S3 connector to push detailed inference logs into our GCP storage (we have a managed bucket and need secure transfer + retention policy).
- Itemized SOW for procurement and a single contract (we expect a one-time onboarding invoice + annual subscription).

Procurement also asked if you can provide a concession on list price; they're pushing for a 30% discount against standard published rates because this would be a multi-region deployment and we are committing to a 12-month usage minimum.

Can you send a line-item quote + SOW so I can run through our approvals? Also our security team will send a short checklist — happy to share it once we have the SOW.

Thanks,
Ana Ruiz
Director of Product Operations
Whitepine Health

Attachments: (none yet — security team will send checklist after SOW)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ana Ruiz <ana@whitepinehealth.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@whitepinehealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-29T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & scope for enterprise bundle (premium support + onboarding + S3 connector)

Hi Ana — really appreciate the clear checklist. Attached is an initial pricing_summary.xlsx (line items + list prices) and a short draft SOW outline. Quick notes up front:

- Premium support + 8-week dedicated onboarding engineer + custom S3 connector are all deliverable, but the connector is custom work outside standard onboarding and will require ~2-3 weeks of eng effort and security review.
- The 30% discount requested is outside of standard sales authority — I am escalating for exec approval because this materially impacts margin on the pro services and first-year ARR.
- Proposed stopgap: we can mark the quote as "subject to exec approval" and start procurement paperwork in parallel if that helps timing.

I am forwarding this to Rishi and Marcus (deal desk) and Vivek for quick review/approval. If we can get an approval window this week we can deliver the SOW and security checklist to your team immediately.

Next steps for us:
- I will open a DocuSign envelope and share as soon as we have final pricing/discount approval.
- Coordinate with your security contact for the checklist (Ken, if you have it, please attach).

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pricing & scope for enterprise bundle — Exec approval requested (Whitepine / DEAL-4873)

Folks — forwarding Whitepine's ask. TL;DR: they want 24/7 premium support + 8-week dedicated onboarding engineer + a custom S3 connector delivered as part of the initial engagement. Procurement is asking for a 30% concession on list.

Why this matters:
- Potential ARR: ~$420k ARR on subscription in year 1 if they convert three regions as discussed (estimates in pricing_summary.xlsx).
- Strategic: reference customer in healthcare vertical; strong case for a regional case study.
- Risk: customization + reduced margin on PS work if we grant a 30% discount and waive the standard onboarding fees.

Specific asks (please approve or provide alternate):
1) Approve a 30% discount off standard subscription pricing for the first 12 months (one-time concession for win).
2) Approve including pro services onboarding (8 weeks) as part of this package and waive the one-time onboarding invoice.
3) Approve custom S3 connector scope as included in the SOW (we estimate 180 engineering hours; see attached Whitepine_SOW_v1.pdf).
4) Approve net-60 payment terms for the one-time SOW invoice (they asked to shorten to net-30, we asked net-90 historically).

Attachments: Whitepine_SOW_v1.pdf (draft SOW with scope and hour estimates).

Notes: if we cannot grant the full 30% discount, recommend we counter with: 20% discount + $45,000 onboarding fee + one-time integration fee (to preserve margin on eng time). If approved I will send the DocuSign and coordinate CS/Delivery start dates.

— Ben
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing & scope for enterprise bundle — Exec approval requested (Whitepine / DEAL-4873)

Thanks Ben — good summary. A few finance/desk points before I sign off:

- Margin impact: a 30% discount across subscription plus waiving onboarding would reduce our first-year gross margin on this deal to ~14% (I modeled the numbers quickly). Recommend alternative to protect unit economics: 20% subscription discount + $45k onboarding + $30k one-time integration fee. That preserves ~36% first-year margin.
- Commitment: require a 12-month minimum and a 60-day early-termination fee on the SOW if they cut short the engagement; keeps risk manageable.
- Payment terms: net-60 for subscription, net-30 for one-time SOW invoice is acceptable to us; we'll not do net-90.
- Security/data: Legal should weigh in on the retention requirement for logs. CCed Rachel (CS lead) to confirm we have a named onboarding resource and the 6/8 week timeline is realistic.

If Vivek is comfortable with the reduced price (20% + fees) I am happy to approve. If the board-level ask is to secure the customer at any cost (and Vivek signs off on 30%), escalate to finance for a one-time discount approval.

— Rishi
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ana Ruiz <ana@whitepinehealth.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@whitepinehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-31T17:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & scope for enterprise bundle (Whitepine / DEAL-4873) — Approved terms pending signature

Hi Ana / Priya — quick update on approval path and next steps.

1) Executive summary: We have leadership alignment to move forward with a concession, but not the full 30% across the board. Rishi proposed an alternative that preserves delivery economics and gets us to a mutually acceptable commercial structure.

Approved commercial terms (pending signature):
- Subscription: 25% discount for the first 12 months (reduced from 30%, increased from Rishi's 20% counter).
- Onboarding: 6-week dedicated onboarding engineer (reduced from 8 weeks); one-time onboarding fee = $25,000 (covers named engineer + runbooks).
- Integration: one-time custom integration fee = $25,000 for S3 connector (covers secure transfer and initial support).
- Commitment: 12-month minimum subscription term.
- Payment terms: net-60 for subscription, net-30 for one-time SOW invoices.

Next steps:
- I will send a DocuSign (link below) with the SOW attached and the revised commercial terms. Please sign to lock pricing and allow our Delivery team to schedule the onboarding resource.
- Rachel (cc) will reach out to schedule a short scoping call next week to confirm integration details and security handoff.

DocuSign (preliminary): https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/abc123-sign
